notes: Reverse-engineer a stripped native codec with no source: recover a three-part transformation (90-degree clockwise geometry, 8-bit bit-reversal tone table, channel-order swap) plus the exact output serialization, purely by observation and/or disassembly. Hard: partial models (geometry-only or table-only) all fail the byte-identical check; the agent must design discriminating probes (1x1 sweeps, orientation probes, distinct-channel probes) and nail canonical formatting. Verifier executes the deliverable on 6 hidden frames plus the visible fixture, byte-compares stdout, hides the native binary during grading, and enforces the no-modify rule on the fixture.
